ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 45% high-intensity (white) pixels localized in distal lobe regions and 55% low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels concentrated in the central peduncle-interface and medial fluke regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs cover the outer 50% of both lobes. The left lobe displays a cleaner white field with black linear streaks at the margin; the right lobe displays a 'salt and pepper' mottling pattern with high-density black pixel clusters interspersed throughout the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel-calculated angle of 55 degrees; depth extends significantly toward the anterior fluke boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the entire boundary; average peak-to-valley amplitude is 15-20 pixels, with more pronounced jaggedness on the inner right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave sweep along the posterior margin, terminating in distinct, upwardly-tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two primary high-contrast circular clusters detected: one at the apex of the left fluke tip and one at the apex of the right fluke tip, consistent with calcareous barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple near-parallel vertical black streaks (rake marks) localized on the ventral surface of the right lobe, cutting through the high-intensity white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable barnacle clusters at the extreme distal points of both lobes; right lobe trailing edge exhibits a irregular indentation/missing segment approx. mid-way between the notch and the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge on the right lobe exhibits a more 'shredded' pixel profile compared to the relatively smoother serration pattern on the left lobe.
